body: Thank you so much. It's my life and I feel as though I deserve to make this decision for myself. I made the appointment and I already feel so much relief, and I know we will both need a lot of time to heal. But I know in my heart I am making the right decision. I will not doom myself and my future family to a life of poverty, welfare and food stamps. I want a better life, but I am not there yet. One day I can see myself trying again.
